_note: v2 hook overrides for la Grande Serre (B64_serre). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace only hooks whose painted scene differs from the source text, or that repeat a motif (caterpillar/butterfly, snail, gardener) used by another word in this building, so each card describes exactly what is in the picture.

fr_changement_noun.why: The butterfly motif is kept for la transition in the stump; a color-changing chameleon is painted here so the two words do not share a picture.

fr_formation_noun.why: Painted as three seedlings in a row with a toy sergeant (no marching band).

fr_transformation_noun.why: Replaces a second caterpillar-to-butterfly scene (used for la transition) with the pumpkin carriage that is painted.

fr_reforme_noun.why: Owner review: the bush is now clipped into the form of a manta ray (was a swan). Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (RAY-FORM -> ray-FORM).

fr_pousse_noun.why: The painted shoot lifts a pebble; the pebble makes the push visible.

fr_transparence_noun.why: No PA or stickers are painted; just the puzzled sparrow at the clear glass.

fr_transition_noun.why: Painted as the butterfly emerging from the chrysalis (the caterpillar stage is not shown).

fr_hausse_noun.why: The steps are painted as rising flowerpots; the painting has no numbers.

fr_amelioration_noun.why: The gardener is left out (a gardener already appears upstairs); the before/after patch and rake show the improvement.

fr_alternative_noun.why: The gardener is painted as a girl holding out the lettuce pot to two slugs.

fr_revision_noun.why: The plan is pinned on a board with the two moles on the shelf beneath, rather than held by a gardener.

fr_emprise_noun.why: The painting shows the giant gripping the greenhouse attic and its frozen roses, not a whole village.

fr_avancee_noun.why: A tortoise replaces the snail, which is already le progrès on the glass downstairs; it is now a plain tortoise (no backpack). Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person now does the action.

fr_remplacement_noun.why: No mechanic is painted; the wheel rolls up the plank to the wheel-less barrow on its own.

fr_avancement_noun.why: The ribbons mark its progress instead of a chart.

fr_epanouissement_noun.why: Owner review: the odd line about a cook is removed.

fr_confection_noun.why: A boy makes the wreath (the girl gardener is already l'alternative). Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person now does the action.

fr_alternance_noun.why: Shows both items at once so the switching is visible in one picture. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person now does the action.

fr_substitution_noun.why: Owner review: the substitution is now done on a submarine (was a snowman's nose).

fr_alteration_noun.why: The painted alteration is a new patch on the jacket, not a new hat and nose. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person now does the action.

fr_accroissement_noun.why: The growth chart is painted as a notched height post.

fr_grandissant_adj.why: The sun is painted in the round window rather than over a horizon.
